set: GK Drill 5: Static: polity, geography, history, science

sections.name: GK drill: Static: polity, geography, history, science

questions.q: The Election Commission of India is provided for under Article:
questions.why: Art. 280 Finance Commission; 315 Public Service Commissions; 148 CAG.

questions.q: The Finance Commission is constituted under Article:
questions.why: Every five years, by the President.

questions.q: Public Service Commissions for the Union and the states are provided for under Article:
questions.why: Art. 312 deals with the All-India Services.

questions.q: The Right to Property was removed from the Fundamental Rights by the:
questions.why: It is now a legal right under Article 300A.

questions.q: Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment, on the recommendation of the:
questions.why: Article 51A; the idea came from the USSR constitution.

questions.q: The voting age was lowered from 21 to 18 by the:
The Concurrent List in the Indian Constitution was borrowed from the Constitution of:
questions.why: The Directive Principles came from Ireland; residuary powers with the Centre from Canada.

questions.q: Who is the present Chief Election Commissioner of India (since February 2025)?
questions.why: The first CEC was Sukumar Sen, who ran the 1951-52 election.

questions.q: The Panchayati Raj system was recommended by the:
questions.why: First introduced at Nagaur, Rajasthan, on 2 October 1959.

questions.q: A Money Bill is defined in Article:
questions.why: Art. 112 is the Annual Financial Statement (budget).

questions.q: Which Indian state has the longest coastline?
questions.why: About 1,600 km.

questions.q: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
questions.why: The Damodar is the 'Sorrow of Bengal'.

questions.q: The highest peak located wholly within India is:
questions.why: K2 is in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir.

questions.q: The longest river of peninsular India is the:
questions.why: Called the 'Dakshin Ganga'.

questions.q: The largest desert in the world is the:
questions.why: A desert is defined by low precipitation; the Sahara is the largest hot desert.

questions.q: The McMahon Line marks the boundary between:
questions.why: Radcliffe: India–Pakistan; Durand: Afghanistan–Pakistan.

questions.q: Laterite soil, common in Goa, is best suited to:
questions.why: Black (regur) soil suits cotton.

questions.q: The Battle of Buxar (1764) was fought between the British and the combined forces of:
opts: Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula and Shah Alam II
questions.why: Plassey (1757) was against Siraj-ud-Daulah.

questions.q: The First Round Table Conference was held in London in:
questions.why: The Congress boycotted it; Gandhi attended the second (1931).

questions.q: India's first satellite, Aryabhata, was launched in:
questions.why: From the Soviet Union. ISRO was founded in 1969.

questions.q: The chemical name of washing soda is:
questions.why: Baking soda is sodium bicarbonate.

questions.q: The ozone layer lies mainly in the:
questions.why: It absorbs ultraviolet radiation.

questions.q: 1 kilobyte (KB) equals:
questions.why: 2 to the power 10.

questions.q: The headquarters of UNESCO is in:
questions.why: WHO and ILO: Geneva; FAO: Rome.

questions.q: The Gol Gumbaz is located in:
questions.why: Tomb of Muhammad Adil Shah, famous for its whispering gallery.
